title: RCLCPP_DEBUG and get_logger().debug() not showing in ROS 2: --log-level, logger names, launch arguments and the logger service, measured
excerpt: Why ROS 2 debug logs stay hidden: INFO default, missing --ros-args, logger names changed by namespace or launch name=, one-string launch arguments, and RCLCPP_LOG_MIN_SEVERITY. Fixes for ros2 run, launch and the Jazzy logger service, measured in rclcpp and rclpy on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
